weapon.d:
For allies within 3 rows or 3 columns centered on unit, grants Atk/Spd+5 and neutralizes penalties on ally during combat.
If unit initiates combat or is within 2 spaces of an ally, grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+5 to unit, neutralizes penalties on unit, and unit deals +X damage during combat (max 15; excluding area-of-effect Specials; X = number of allies within 3 rows or 3 columns centered on unit × 5; calculates damage from staff after combat damage is added).

assist.d: Restores 8 HP to target ally. Range = 2.
Restores HP = 50% of Atk. (Minimum of 8 HP.) Range = 2.

special.d: When healing an ally with a staff, restores an additional 10 HP to target ally.
When healing an ally with a staff, grants Spd+4 to all allies for 1 turn.
When healing an ally with a staff, grants Atk/Spd+4 to all allies for 1 turn.

a.d: If unit is within 2 spaces of an ally, grants Atk/Spd+X to unit during combat (X = number of allies within 2 spaces; max 3).
If unit is within 2 spaces of an ally, grants Atk/Spd+X to unit during combat (X = number of allies within 2 spaces + 2; max 5).
If unit is within 2 spaces of an ally, grants Atk/Spd+X to unit during combat (X = 2 × number of allies within 2 spaces, + 1; max 7).

c.d: Inflicts Spd/Res-2 on foes within 2 spaces during combat.
Inflicts Spd/Res-3 on foes within 2 spaces during combat.
Inflicts Spd/Res-4 on foes within 2 spaces during combat.
